_about: In Loving Memory entries added on deploy by kop_apply_memorial_seeds() (inc/admin.php). Each is inserted once, skipped when memorial_victims already has a row with the same name, program and date. Rows edited on the page are never touched. Source of the first 2026-10-23 batch: the owner's Death Toll sheet (rows with a source that were not on the page; 'sheet_row' is the row there). Second batch ('news_ids'): deaths in KOP's news archive that were not on the page (docs/plan/4.3 item 16).
